panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Drops to zero on every restart. A sawtooth here is the first sign of something rebooting at night.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, uptime_s FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Free heap
panels.description: Flat is healthy. A downward trend over days is a leak, long before it crashes anything.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, heap_free FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wi-Fi signal
panels.description: Separates a radio problem from a firmware problem. Below about -75 dBm expect dropouts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, rssi_dbm FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Messages per hour
panels.description: The board publishes one aggregate every 5 min, so 12 an hour is healthy. A short spike is the BOOT button or a backlog being uploaded after a trip; a dip is a connection that was down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', received_at) AS time, count(*) AS messages FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Samples per window
panels.description: How many measurements went into each aggregate. At 10 s measuring and a 5 min window the answer is 30. Consistently fewer means the board is missing measurements; 1 marks a spot reading from the BOOT button or the first message after a restart.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, n FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND n IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
